- **`api-backend.query-contract-matrix` clause 6** (product-defect): A malformed JSON request body is silently parsed as {} by the hono adapter, so a truncated POST /data/:object/query answers 200 with the full table, and a malformed create writes an empty row
  - repro: Fresh os dev boot of showcase; sign in as admin (bearer). (1) POST /api/v1/data/showcase_account/query, content-type application/json, body {"where": {"status": "churned"}} -> 200, 2 rows. (3) POST /api/v1/data/<an object with no required fields> with body "{ not json" -> expected 400, actual 201 creating an empty row. Reproduced twice (run 1 and 2: well-formed 2, truncated 200 26/26).
